6d3a0d58-20a3-570d-91e7-aa8f10dafb5a.title: Writing a Triple Integral as a Repeated Integral

e-11585.knowledge_point: Writing a Triple Integral as a Repeated Integral
e-11585.problem:
Express the triple integral 

$$
\displaystyle 
\iiint\limits_{R} (x+y+z)^2 \: \textrm{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R = \bigg\{ (x,y,z) \: : \: 0 \leq x \leq 1, \: -1 \leq y \leq 2, \: 0\leq z \leq 2 \bigg\}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
\displaystyle 
\int_a^b  \int_c^d  \int_e^f \ldots \: \textrm{d}y\:  \textrm{d}z\:  \textrm{d}x .
$$
e-11585.worked_solution:
Given the limits for $x,y,$ and $z,$ we can express our triple integral as a repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}(x+y+z)^{2}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}(x+y+z)^{2}\,\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

before.name: Question 1
before.problem:
Express the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}(x+2y)^{2}\,\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 4,\,0\le y\le 1,\,0\le z\le 3}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{c}^{d}{\int }_{e}^{f}…\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.
$$

Express the triple integral
∭R(x+2y)2dV over the box R={(x,y,z):0≤x≤4,0≤y≤1,0≤z≤3} as a repeated integral of the form ∫ab∫cd∫ef…dydzdx.

a
∫03∫01∫04(x+2y)2dydzdx
b
∫01∫04∫03(x+2y)2dydzdx
c
∫01∫03∫04(x+2y)2dydzdx
d
∫04∫03∫01(x+2y)2dydzdx
e
∫03∫04∫01(x+2y)2dydzdx
Submit

decision.explanation: The order dy dz dx places y in the innermost integral with bounds 0 to 1, z in the middle with bounds 0 to 3, and x in the outermost with bounds 0 to 4. Thus option d expresses the integral over the given box.

after.name: Question 1
after.problem:
Express the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}(x+2y)^{2}\,\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 4,\,0\le y\le 1,\,0\le z\le 3}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{c}^{d}{\int }_{e}^{f}…\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.
$$
after.worked_solution:
Given the limits for $x,y,$ and $z,$ we can express our triple integral as a repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}(x+2y)^{2}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}(x+2y)^{2}\,\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

content.knowledge_point: Writing a Triple Integral as a Repeated Integral
content.problem:
Express the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}(x+2y)^{2}\,\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 4,\,0\le y\le 1,\,0\le z\le 3}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{c}^{d}{\int }_{e}^{f}…\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.
$$
content.worked_solution:
Given the limits for $x,y,$ and $z,$ we can express our triple integral as a repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}(x+2y)^{2}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}(x+2y)^{2}\,\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$
